title: 1 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on 1 Kings 3: Solomon asks God for an understanding heart and judges between two mothers.

questions.text: Whose daughter did Solomon take as part of an alliance?
questions.explanation: Solomon made an alliance with Pharaoh king of Egypt and took Pharaoh's daughter.

questions.text: Where was the great high place where Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings?
questions.explanation: The king went to Gibeon to sacrifice, for that was the great high place, and offered a thousand burnt offerings there.

questions.text: How did Yahweh appear to Solomon in Gibeon?
questions.explanation: In Gibeon, Yahweh appeared to Solomon in a dream by night and said, "Ask for what I should give you."

questions.text: How did Solomon describe himself in his answer to God?
questions.explanation: Solomon said, "I am just a little child. I don't know how to go out or come in."

answers.text: As the wisest man in Israel
As an old man near death

questions.text: What did Solomon ask God to give him?
questions.explanation: Solomon asked for an understanding heart to judge God's people, so that he could discern between good and evil.

questions.text: Besides wisdom, what did God also give Solomon that he had not asked for?
questions.explanation: God said he had given Solomon a wise and understanding heart, and had also given him what he had not asked: both riches and honor.

questions.text: How did the one woman say the other woman's child had died?
questions.explanation: The one woman said, "This woman's child died in the night, because she lay on it."

answers.text: It fell sick with a fever
She lay on it in the night
It was taken by a stranger

questions.text: What did the king call for after the two women argued before him?
questions.explanation: The two women argued before the king; then the king said, "Get me a sword," and they brought a sword before him.

questions.text: To whom did the king give the living child?
questions.explanation: The real mother said, "Give her the living child, and in no way kill him!" The king said to give her the living child, for she was his mother.

answers.text: The woman who said not to kill him
A nurse from the king's house
The priest who stood at the ark

questions.text: Why did all Israel fear the king after this judgment?
questions.explanation: All Israel heard of the judgment and feared the king, for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him, to do justice.

answers.text: He had a great army of chariots
He punished the lying woman with death
He had built the wall of Jerusalem
They saw the wisdom of God was in him to do justice
